description: This is a PHP source file defining the DiscoverController class within the Goteo project. It handles project discovery functionalities, including search and filtering of projects based on various criteria like category, location, status, and type. It includes methods for rendering project lists and processing AJAX search requests.

classes.name: DiscoverController
classes.description: Controller class managing project discovery, search, and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets database replica and cache, and theme for views.

methods.name: getProjectFilters
methods.description: Generates a set of filters for retrieving projects based on user input and predefined criteria.

methods.name: searchAction
methods.description: Handles the display of project search results with various filters applied.

methods.name: ajaxSearchAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests for dynamic project search and returns JSON with project data.
